# Appeal of Denial — Hip Arthroscopy (CPT 29914)

**Governing Policy:** Cigna CMM-314 Hip Surgery - Arthroscopic and Open Procedures V1.0.2026 (https://www.evicore.com/sites/default/files/clinical-guidelines/2026-04/Cigna_CMM-314%20Hip%20Surg%20Arthro%20%26%20Open%20Proc_V1.0.2026_Eff08.04.2026_Pub04.20.2026.pdf)

**Member:** Taylor Kimura
**Member ID:** W354999576
**Denial date:** 2026-07-31
**Reference number:** POC-37F3AA304D-16940
**Payer/Plan:** Cigna (Commercial/ACA), Kansas

Dear Cigna Appeals Department,

I am appealing the denial of my prior authorization request for hip arthroscopy (CPT 29914). My claim was denied for "incomplete documentation," stating that the submitted records did not allow a determination of medical necessity. I am requesting a reconsideration of this decision. My surgeon, Dr. Okafor, has documented that this procedure is medically necessary, and I believe the records already in my file address the plan's own published criteria.

## The Plan's Criteria and My Records

Cigna's policy states that "femoroacetabular impingement (FAI) is considered medically necessary when ALL of the following criteria have been met:"

The policy lists these required elements: "◦ positive anterior impingement sign (i.e., groin-dominant hip pain with forced hip flexion, adduction, and internal rotation) ◦ limited passive hip internal rotation • Failure of provider-directed non-surgical management for at least three (3) months' duration AND which must include the following (unless contraindicated):"

Here is how my records address each part:

- **Groin-dominant pain and limited motion:** My chart documents sharp anterior groin pain with sitting and pivoting, an inability to run or squat, positive provocative testing on the affected side, and range of motion limited by pain.
- **Failure of non-surgical management for at least three months:** I completed 16 weeks (24 visits) of supervised physical therapy focused on core and hip stabilization with activity modification, from 2026-02-23 to 2026-06-15, as documented in my physical therapy discharge note. I also took NSAIDs for 4 months with inadequate relief, and I had a corticosteroid injection on 2026-03-21 that gave only 4 weeks of partial relief.
- **Diagnostic imaging:** An MRI arthrogram of my hip on 2026-06-24 showed an anterosuperior labral tear with cam-type femoroacetabular impingement, an alpha angle of 68 degrees, preserved joint space, and Tonnis grade 0.

The policy separately states that surgery "is considered not medically necessary for ANY other indication or condition, including ANY of the following radiographic findings," but the specific list of excluded radiographic findings was not included in the documents provided to me for this appeal, so I am not able to compare my imaging results against that list here. Nothing in my chart suggests that my findings fall outside the plan's medically necessary criteria, and I would ask that this be reviewed against the full non-indications list in the policy.

My case does not involve synovectomy, in-office diagnostic arthroscopy, capsular plication, or anterior inferior iliac spine/subspinous decompression, so those sections of the policy do not appear to apply to my request.

## Request

Given that my records document groin-dominant pain, limited motion, more than three months of provider-directed non-surgical treatment including physical therapy, NSAIDs, and an injection, and imaging showing cam-type FAI with a labral tear, I am asking Cigna to reconsider this denial and review the complete documentation from my prior authorization packet. If any specific record is still considered missing, please let me know exactly what is needed so my surgeon's office can provide it promptly.

Please send your decision, and any request for additional information, to the address on file for me. I understand my appeal must be received by 2027-01-27, and I am submitting it through my.cigna.com / by calling 1-800-244-6224, using the appeal address printed on my denial letter as the authoritative mailing address.

Thank you for reviewing this appeal.

Sincerely,

______________________________
Taylor Kimura
Member ID: W354999576
Date: [date of signature]
Contact phone: [phone number]
Contact email: [email address]

---

*This letter is not medical or legal advice and does not guarantee that coverage will be approved.*
